description: The path of one request from a phone to a backend server: DNS, anycast, CDN edges, reverse proxies, L4 and L7 load balancers, API gateways, HTTP/1.1 vs 2 vs 3 and TLS termination, explained for a networking engineer.

hero.html:
Level 2 - Beginner 40 min HLD Networking

Networking for HLD: DNS, Proxies, LBs & API Gateways

After this page you can draw the full path of one request, from "user types a URL" to "a server answers", name every box on that path, and say in an interview why you picked an L4 or an L7 load balancer, where TLS ends, and what the CDN and the API gateway are doing there.
